result.title: Multi-Turn Semantic Caching for Low-Cost LLM Serving
result.summary: Semantic caching lowers the cost of serving large language models (LLMs) by reusing stored responses for similar requests. In multi-turn conversations, whether a cached response is acceptable depends on both conversations' histories, which embedding similarity of requests and histories predicts poorly (AUC 0.62--0.74 on five workloads). We therefore learn the \emph{reuse risk}, the probability that a cached response is unacceptable, from judge feedback, and choose a budgeted set of conversation states to cache by weighing the generation cost a reuse avoids against a price for unacceptable reuse. We propose CUCB-SC-MT, which learns a cache from logged conversations with a suboptimality guarantee, and CLCB-LS-MT, which learns online and has $\tilde O(\sqrt N)$ regret over $N$ requests when conversation states recur. On math-tutoring (SocraTeach) and movie-ticketing (Taskmaster-3) conversations, both achieve lower loss than prior semantic caching approaches: ContextCache, multi-turn variants of ElastiCache and vCache, and single-turn semantic caching at every cache budget. With 1,000 cache entries, CLCB-LS-MT avoids 35--41\% of the generation cost through acceptable reuses, against at most 22--25\% for the baselines, and lowers estimated serving latency by 19--35\%.

AI.brief_summary: 针对多轮对话中的语义缓存，指出请求与历史的 embedding 相似度难以预测缓存响应是否可复用（AUC 0.62–0.74），转而从 judge 反馈学习「复用风险」，并用带预算的选择在生成成本与不可接受复用代价间权衡，提出离线学习的 CUCB-SC-MT 与在线学习的 CLCB-LS-MT，后者对 N 个请求有 Õ(√N) 遗憾界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「相似度高不等于可复用」的实证对 latent 相似度指标是否反映内容可用性、以及基于缓存的复用/停止决策可供核查，但该方法作用于请求—响应缓存层面而非 latent 推理状态，迁移性需人工判断。
